text:
Ana: Quick thread — ran a perf sweep across A10/T4/L4/A100/H100 to tune max_tokens_per_batch and max_batch_size. High-level: H100 shows a regression for long sequences (>2048) because the kernel selector falls back to a non-fused path. T4/A10 are memory-constrained when KV cache is hot. Posting profiler highlights and a suggested per-GPU ceiling list. Thoughts?

Raj: can you paste the top-line numbers (p50/p95 latency delta and throughput change) so we have something concrete?

Ana: Top-line from 30m steady-state runs (mixed short+long workload):
- A10: throughput +8% with max_tokens_per_batch=16k, p95 -6%
- T4: throughput +5% with 12k, p95 -3% (but memory pressure noticeable with KV enabled)
- L4: throughput +4% with 20k, p95 -2%
- A100: throughput +12% with 48k, p95 -10%
- H100: throughput -18% with 96k on runs containing seq>2048 (p95 up +23%) — profiler shows kernel selector picking non-fused attention for many blocks which thrashes perf.

Maria: If the H100 regression is a selector mismatch, two options: force the fused kernel for H100 (experimental) or cap the token ceiling for long sequences. I prefer the cap for safety: e.g., reduce long-seq H100 ceiling to 48k and keep short-seq default at 64k.

Kai: Queue policy notes: we should prefer short-first packing (SJF-ish) and make token-budget per-device instead of global. Also enable KV-aware packing that avoids combining many KV-hot requests into one big token batch on memory-limited GPUs. Proposed per-device token ceilings (initial):
- A10: max_batch_size=48, max_tokens_per_batch=24000
- T4: max_batch_size=32, max_tokens_per_batch=16000
- L4: max_batch_size=48, max_tokens_per_batch=28000
- A100: max_batch_size=128, max_tokens_per_batch=64000
- H100: max_batch_size=128, max_tokens_per_batch=48000 (reduced for long-seq safety)
Also add a dynamic override: if avg_seq_len > 1024 across the last 10s, reduce H100 ceiling by 25% to avoid kernel thrash.

Ana: example config snippet to put in runtime config (for experiments):
```json
{
  "per_gpu_limits": {
    "A10": {"max_batch_size": "48", "max_tokens_per_batch": "24000"},
    "T4":  {"max_batch_size": "32", "max_tokens_per_batch": "16000"},
    "L4":  {"max_batch_size": "48", "max_tokens_per_batch": "28000"},
    "A100":{"max_batch_size": "128","max_tokens_per_batch": "64000"},
    "H100":{"max_batch_size": "128","max_tokens_per_batch": "48000"}
  },
  "queue_policy": "short_first_kv_safe",
  "dynamic_overrides": {"avg_seq_len_threshold": "1024", "h100_ceiling_reduction_pct": "25"}
}
```

Raj: note — on T4 with KV cache enabled, I saw baseline mem go up ~10% when moving from 8k -> 12k tokens/batch; fragmentation spikes when we evict old KV shards. We should cap concurrent batches on T4 until we validate fragmentation patterns.

deploy-bot: perfbot snapshot: 2026-02-11T15:03:02Z — A100: throughput +12% (sig), H100: tail latency +23% on seq>2048. Full profiles uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/profiles/2026-02-11/2012345678.tar.gz

Maria: Action items I will take: (1) PR for per-gpu ceiling config + unit tests, (2) flag to force fused kernel on H100 for an A/B experiment, (3) 48h canary (top 3 customers) once PR merges. I'll also add a simple dashboard with avg_seq_len and kernel_selector_mismatch rate.

Ana: SGTM. @Raj can you run the KV mem/fragmentation test matrix on T4 for ceilings [8k,12k,16k] and post logs? I'll update the RFC with the suggested numbers and the perfbot links.

Kai: also recommend adding a short-term fallback: if kernel_selector_mismatch_rate > 5% on H100 for 30s, throttle max_tokens_per_batch by 30% automatically to avoid regression spikes.

Ana: thanks all — let's keep this thread for follow-ups. I will attach the PR link once created.
